[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] incumbent [[Mark Warner]] is seeking a fourth term. He is being challenged by [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Army general [[Bert Mizusawa]]. In the August 4 [[primary elections]], Warner was unopposed for the Democratic nomination. Mizusawa won the Republican nomination with 51.5% of the vote over Marine Corps Reserves officer David Williams and financial accountant Kim Farington. Republicans have not won a Senate election in Virginia since [[2002 United States Senate election in Virginia|2002]]. == Democratic primary == === Candidates === ==== Nominee ==== *[[Mark Warner]], incumbent U.S. senator (2009–present){{cite web |last1=Shokraei |first1=Carrie |date=December 2, 2025 |title=Sen.
